suites: 36 synthetic fixtures = six fault types × six numeric-detail seeds. Six distinct categorical decision problems; not 36 independent fault mechanisms.

policies.checklist: logs, pool, queue, probe, diff, cache, metrics; stop at singleton
policies.adaptive: greatest expected candidate elimination per abstract tool cost; equal priors; stop at singleton

cost: Abstract tool units, not tokens, money or API calls. Local JS CPU duration includes simulation observations and policy logic; no model latency measured.
